title: UserRegistered Event
description: Published when a new user account is successfully created on the Aegis platform.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance. Used for idempotent consumption by downstream services.

userId.description: The unique identifier of the newly registered user (UUID v7).

email.description: The normalized email address of the registered user.

registeredAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the account was created.

correlationId.description: Request correlation ID for distributed tracing. Injected by the API Gateway.
